chapters.title: One place to see every machine

takeaways: Azure Update Manager brings assessment, scheduling, installation and update history for Windows and Linux servers into one Azure-native service, with Azure Arc extending it to on-premises and other clouds.
Separate maintenance windows and patch rings (dev/test, production pilot, wider production) plus agreed reboot rules prevent surprise outages.
A finished schedule is not proof: use update history and the compliance view to find and follow up on the machines that still miss security updates.
hook: Patch night often means scattered tools, unclear ownership and servers that silently miss security updates. This episode explains Azure Update Manager for IT admins running Azure VMs and Arc-connected servers, and shows how assessment, maintenance windows and compliance history turn patching into a repeatable, provable process.
